mission: Convert Kim Kagiso Mosiane's strongest applied-AI and automation systems into independently inspectable, deployed, observable and portfolio-demonstrable implementations without inflating maturity or creating parallel control planes.
success_state: provider execution is independently read back where applicable
target deployment has health persistence and rollback proof
one real user journey is demonstrable
CV claims match exact verified scope
operating_rules: close the shortest high-value proof gap first
no stage jump over missing proof
no project-wide trust inheritance from a narrower route
no deployment claim from source or configuration
no provider claim from generic HTTP success
no new meta-framework while a flagship has an executable proof gap unless the new component directly closes that gap
every material boundary becomes an AO-CRA build
prefer complete vertical slices over architectural breadth
